summary: Replaced silent catch blocks with error logging in middleware.ts, lib/auth.ts, and signout route

finding: Middleware, lib/auth.ts, and signout route all had bare catch blocks that silently swallowed errors
action: Added console.error with context labels [Auth] prefix for traceability

description: Middleware follows safe default - public routes fail open (allow access) but admin routes fail closed (block access)
rationale: Maintains UX while keeping admin security tight
Enables filtering logs by category in production observability
Server logs enable debugging, user messages remain friendly without leaking internals
